text:
maria (partnerships): Heads-up — CloudCorp just asked to onboard a Seoul region listing (asia-northeast3) to the marketplace. They want entitlement & quota live by mid-May. Need confirmation on capacity, required Marketplace docs, and any red flags. cc @sam @lee @jordan :eyes:

sam (cloud-ops): Do we have the target SKUs and billing account? Also need the GCP project IDs for quota requests.

lee (eng-ml): Quick technical check — what hardware are they planning? A100s or T4s? For our inference profiles, A100 capacity affects KV cache sizing and per-node memory.

jordan (solutions): We'll need a customer-facing enablement doc + runbook. I can re-use the EU onboarding flow but will need the marketplace entitlement link and legal checklist.

hanna (cloudcorp): Hi all — we can initially provision up to 8x A100 (shared pool) in seoul. Marketplace requires entitlements + partner legal PO. Our marketplace PM asked for MPN ID and the listing sku names. We can start the entitlement flow once we have the Redwood MPN and contact.

maria (partnerships): Thanks Hanna. Redwood MPN: RWD-1427. SKUs that matter: `redwood_inference.dedicated.a100` and `redwood_inference.hosted.standard`. For quota request, we probably need both GPUs and regional VM quota.

sam (cloud-ops): I'll open a GCP quota ticket once we have project IDs and the estimated vCPU/GPU numbers. Can you send the expected QPS and concurrency? Also we need the billing account (or marketplace SA) for marketplace entitlements.

hanna (cloudcorp): We'll accept the marketplace billing link. Estimated initial QPS is ~120 req/s across models, peak concurrency ~45. We expect to scale to double in 6 weeks.

lee (eng-ml): For 120 req/s with low-latency gen models, recommend reserving 4x A100 initially. If they scale fast we should add KV cache nodes; otherwise memory will spike. Suggest we keep fallback routing to `eu-west1` if seoul capacity hits the quota.

jordan (solutions): I'll draft the enablement doc. Action items: (1) Redwood to supply project IDs + billing, (2) CloudCorp to start marketplace entitlement, (3) Legal to review addendum for Korea data residency.

olivia (legal): I'll review the addendum. Need to see the data flow diagram and whether KMS keys are customer-managed in SE-Asia. Also check for any cross-border transfer clauses.

sam (cloud-ops): Example quota request we'll submit to GCP support (fill placeholders):
```
{
  "project": "projects/REPLACE_WITH_PROJECT",
  "region": "asia-northeast3",
  "quota": {
    "A100": 8,
    "vCPU": 256
  },
  "justification": "Marketplace onboarding for Redwood Inference customer workloads — initial capacity for production testing"
}
```

hanna (cloudcorp): Noted. I'll get the legal PO looped and MPN link. Can you share the Redwood marketplace account email so our PM can grant access?

maria (partnerships): Set: marketplace-admin@redwood.ai — I'll send access now. Tentative timeline: entitlement request started by Mon, legal + compliance reviews by Wed, quota requests to GCP Thu, target live mid-next week.

jordan (solutions): Can we schedule a 30m sync with CloudCorp PM + infra team Thursday 09:00 PT to finalize quotas and runbook?

hanna (cloudcorp): That works for me. I'll send a calendar invite with the marketplace PM and infra lead. :+1:

sam (cloud-ops): One dependency — we need the region KMS key ARN/location before we can enable customer-managed keys for seoul. Please include KMS owner in the invite.

lee (eng-ml): Also flag: if they want 16-bit quantized models we can run more capacity on A100 but need to validate model accuracy. I'll prep a perf checklist.

maria (partnerships): Great. I'll create a follow-up doc and attach the runbook template + security checklist. Moving next steps into the partnership tracker. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
